"""DexToolBench brush controller, using only recorded joint targets."""
import os
os.environ.setdefault('RCB_MUJOCO_GL','egl')
import numpy as np
import mujoco, rcb_dtb
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from PIL import Image

class Controller:
 def __init__(self):
  self.s=rcb_dtb.Session('/app/instance.json'); self.m=self.s.model; self.d=self.s.data
  self.k=mujoco.MjData(self.m); self.bid=self.m.body('palmleft_hand_C_MC').id
  self.jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv)); self.jr=self.jp.copy()
  self.q=rcb_dtb.INIT_Q.copy()
 def pose(self): return self.d.xpos[self.bid].copy(),self.d.xmat[self.bid].reshape(3,3).copy()
 def ik(self,p,R,q=None):
  q=self.q.copy() if q is None else q.copy()
  self.k.qpos[:]=self.d.qpos
  for _ in range(120):
   self.k.qpos[self.s._jq]=q; mujoco.mj_forward(self.m,self.k)
   ep=np.asarray(p)-self.k.xpos[self.bid]; er=Rot.from_matrix(R@self.k.xmat[self.bid].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()
   e=np.r_[ep,er*.3]
   if np.linalg.norm(e)<1e-5: break
   mujoco.mj_jacBody(self.m,self.k,self.jp,self.jr,self.bid)
   J=np.vstack([self.jp[:,:7],self.jr[:,:7]*.3])
   dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.eye(6)*1e-5,e)
   dq=np.clip(dq,-.15,.15); q[:7]=np.clip(q[:7]+dq,self.s.lower[:7]+.001,self.s.upper[:7]-.001)
  return q
 def step(self,q):
  self.q=q.copy(); return self.s.step(q)
 def move(self,p,R,h=None,n=120):
  q=self.ik(p,R)
  if h is not None: q[7:]=h
  q0=self.q.copy()
  for i in range(n):
   t=(i+1)/n; a=t*t*(3-2*t); self.step(q0+(q-q0)*a)
  return np.linalg.norm(self.pose()[0]-p)
 def hold(self,n=60):
  for _ in range(n): self.step(self.q)
 def snap(self,name):
  Image.fromarray(self.s.render_grid(size=(640,480))).save('/app/output/'+name+'.png')
 def report(self,name):
  print(name,self.s.steps,self.s.progress(),'obj',self.d.xpos[self.s._obj], 'palm',self.pose()[0],flush=True)
  cs=[]
  for c in self.d.contact:
   b1,b2=self.m.geom_bodyid[c.geom1],self.m.geom_bodyid[c.geom2]
   if self.s._obj in [b1,b2]:
    b=b2 if b1==self.s._obj else b1
    cs.append(self.m.body(b).name)
  print('contacts',dict((b,cs.count(b)) for b in set(cs)),flush=True)

def hand(f=1.,thumb=(1.3,0,.6,0,.7)):
 h=np.zeros(22);h[:5]=thumb
 for i in [5,9,13,18]:h[i:i+4]=[f,0,f,f]
 return h

def trial():

 ob=c.d.xpos[s._obj].copy();R=np.array([[0,1,0],[0,0,-1],[-1,0,0]])
